note: I2, the anchored item re-roll (art plan batch I). 2026-10-30. One create_1_direction_object job: no size (the 16x16 style images set it: 64 candidates), view top-down, palette = the 46 Apollo hexes, palette_name Apollo, name i2_items, 10 generations. style_images = 8 approved I1 icons rendered as art:build places them (art/ref/anchors_i1/style_images.json: i_iron_ore, i_copper_ingot, i_engine_glass, i_drill_bit, i_chorus_crystal, i_circuit, i_heartstone, i_spore_dust). PixelLab review object a9c8d099-3367-4c3a-a5c2-d982ee759078 (job c53e69e6-1060-48e9-9165-6393ae2975c6). All 64 frames are kept untouched in art/raw/i2/candidates/frame_<i>.png (slot order in art/raw/i2/slots.json and _slots). The anchors worked: 59 of 64 came back inside the 12x12 envelope (I1: 3 of 64) and most with a closed #090a14 outline, so 5 picks are used as drawn and the rest needed only a rim close or a whole-colour ramp fix (scripts/art/itemfit.ts, parameters in _fix and art/edits/i2/fits.tsv); only cut_crystal lost two rows. The three slots of one prompt came back nearly identical. Rejects keep their code-drawn art (_rejected).
_prompt: description: tiny game item icon, centered with an empty transparent margin, closed 1px black outline, lit from upper left, no shadow ('dark navy' in I1 gave #1e1d39 outlines). item_descriptions: the 19 I1 rejects (cut_crystal added), each rewritten from the art plan line to fix what I1 got wrong (art/raw/i2/descriptions.json).
_slots: 0-56: iron_ingot, iron_plate, gear, copper_wire, reinforced_plate, coal, steel_ingot, steel_beam, motor, sapstone, glowcap, mycelium, filter, cobalt_drill_head, cut_crystal, resonant_core, cold_ember_ingot, ember_core, heat_shield, three slots each in that order; 57-63 fourth tries: motor, copper_wire, gear, coal, steel_beam, cobalt_drill_head, glowcap.

_rejected.i_filter: 36, 37, 38: a round lime disc with a red-orange rim reads as a citrus slice; the code-drawn square brass filter reads better
_rejected.i_resonant_core: 45, 46, 47: a busy mosaic again (cyan, brass, red and green pixels); the code-drawn orb stays
_rejected.alternates_not_used: 1/2 iron_ingot (weaker highlight), 3/5 iron_plate (alike), 6-8 gear (axle hole filled with white), 10/11/58 copper_wire (alike), 12/14 reinforced_plate (14 has a blue rivet), 15/17/60 coal (17 has no glint, 60 2 px at 3:1), 18/19 steel_ingot (outline gaps), 22/23/61 steel_beam (alike), 24/57 motor (13 px wide) and 25 (alike), 28/29 sapstone (28 has #73bed3), 30-32 glowcap (cap-only blobs, weak stem), 33/34 mycelium (alike), 39/40/62 cobalt_drill_head (#73bed3 pixels, or a brown collar), 42/43 cut_crystal (alike), 49/50 cold_ember_ingot (alike), 51/53 ember_core (less orange), 54/56 heat_shield (alike)
